llm.summary: This instruction-only skill is internally consistent with its description: it uses curl to call mkts.io endpoints and optionally accepts an MKTS_API_KEY — no unrelated credentials, installs, or file access are requested.

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions only show curl commands targeting https://mkts.io and an optional registration POST that submits an email/name to mkts.io. The skill does not instruct reading arbitrary local files, other env vars, system paths, or sending data to unrelated endpoints. Note: registering an API key will transmit an email/name to the mkts service (expected for key issuance).

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk, but consider these practical checks before use: (1) Only provide an MKTS_API_KEY if you trust mkts.io — prefer a dedicated/limited key; (2) registering for a key will send your email/name to mkts.io, so use an address you’re comfortable sharing; (3) verify the mkts.io domain and its privacy/rate-limit policies if you care about data handling; (4) monitor outbound network activity if you want to ensure the agent only calls mkts.io; (5) avoid supplying any unrelated secrets or reusing highly privileged credentials as MKTS_API_KEY.
